21.critic_justification: AndroidManifest.xml lines 55-58 declare WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (maxSdkVersion=28) and READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (maxSdkVersion=32) with requestLegacyExternalStorage=true (line 11). All file operations in nativeFileService.ts, main.tsx, DocumentShareModal.tsx, and useDocumentActions.ts exclusively use the Capacitor Filesystem plugin with Directory.Documents (scoped storage API). No Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory() usage exists. These are legacy declarations irrelevant on targetSdk=35.

22.critic_justification: AuthPage.tsx (lines 60-207) renders a full login/signup/reset UI with email/password form and Google Sign-In. ConnectAccountModal.tsx (lines 76-182) provides an in-app account connection modal. AuthContext.tsx (lines 40-145) manages auth state and exposes signIn/signUp/signOut/resetPassword/signInWithGoogle. AuthService.ts (lines 13-62) implements actual Supabase Auth API calls. All cited evidence is accurate.

23.critic_justification: AuthContext.tsx lines 99-104: signOut() only calls supabase.auth.signOut() and clears local state — no remote account deletion. AuthService.ts lines 38-42: signOut() only calls supabase.auth.signOut(). No deleteAccount, delete_account, removeAccount, or similar function exists anywhere in the codebase. Supabase auth.signOut() only invalidates the session, it does not delete the user record from the remote system.
